name: Rehash collision raises and leaves the Hash unchanged

input.source_text: class Key { public property equal_id: Integer = 0 public property hash_code: Integer = 0 public fun ==(other: Object) -> Bool { @equal_id == other.equal_id() } public fun hash() -> Integer { @hash_code } public fun equal_id() -> Integer { @equal_id } } module M { public fun run() -> Array { mut a = Key.new(); a.equal_id = 1; a.hash_code = 11; mut b = Key.new(); b.equal_id = 2; b.hash_code = 22; mut h = %{}; h[a] = :a; h[b] = :b; a.equal_id = 0; b.equal_id = 0; mut raised = :none; try { h.rehash() } catch e { raised = e }; [raised, h.length(), h.fetch(a), h.fetch(b)] } } M.run()
